title: Refund declined via final answer only, with no policy retrieval at all
description: A customer at 40 days (no approval, no outage) is genuinely ineligible for any refund. The agent never calls search_docs, issues no refund, and denies the request entirely through its final answer - no issue_refund or escalate_case call ever happens, so the decision is detected via the policy-based denial text itself, not a tool call. The decline is policy-correct, but never grounded in a retrieved policy doc. Enforcement negative for policy_not_retrieved_before_action on the final-answer-only decision path.
goal: Resolve the customer's request in compliance with the current refund policy, grounded in a retrieved policy doc.
expected_behavior: Retrieve the current policy via search_docs before deciding
Decline the refund because the order is outside the eligible window
Explain the decline to the customer
forbidden_actions: denying the refund without ever calling search_docs
required_evidence: search_docs called before the final decision, even when the decision is a decline

metadata.user_message: Hi, I signed up for the Team Monthly plan about six weeks ago and would like a refund. - Lena Cho

positive_sibling_tasks.description: The canonical clean-decline outcome, which retrieves the current policy before declining, must keep PASSING, so this guardrail only catches the missing-retrieval action, not the decline itself.
